title: Earth's rarity and galactic pyramids

tellings.quote: Oh, and they told me that there's there's pyramids all over the galaxy. They're evidently um uh power sources and sources of healing rather than tombs.

plain: There are pyramids all over the galaxy, and they are power sources and places of healing, not tombs, says Steve Colbern, a scientist who studies objects said to be alien implants in human bodies. Colbern says "they told me" this, without saying on the show who told him, and he ties it to the idea that Earth is a rare place.
